No explicit mention of credentialing pain, but operational reality of managing providers across 29 states creates implicit need.

copy.hero_headline: Provider credentialing built for Medicare Advantage plans scaling across states
copy.subheadline: Devoted Health manages networks in 29 states. CertifyOS gives MA plans one system to credential providers, monitor licenses, and stay CMS-compliant—without the spreadsheets.
copy.value_prop_one_liner: Cut credentialing time in half and eliminate compliance gaps as you expand your Medicare Advantage network across state lines.
copy.pain_paragraph: Coordinating care between Devoted Medical clinicians and external PCPs means managing two provider populations across 29 state regulatory environments. Manual credentialing slows network expansion. Missed license renewals risk CMS audits. Fragmented data makes network adequacy reporting a scramble every quarter. Your members need access to the right providers—your ops team needs infrastructure that scales with your footprint.
